card.name: Words leading up to a vote
card.fires_on: Words just before a vote or ballot is expected in civic text, such as ballot propositions, referendums, or constitutional amendment procedures. It fires on small words like 'a', 'to', 'of' and on numbers in proposition names.

modes.label: Ballot propositions
modes.description: Numbers and the word Proposition in lists of state ballot measures.
modes.example: Two of these measures,<< Proposition>> 30 and Proposition 38

modes.label: Constitutional procedure
modes.description: Words inside lists of actions that need a vote, such as proposing an amendment.
modes.example: to convict in an impeachment and to propose<< a>> constitutional amendment.

modes.label: Referendum history
modes.description: Words in accounts of referendums and approval by a government or convention.
modes.example: without the approval<< of>> the Quebec government.
